answer: Bind each identity to one hardware anchor: a trellis allows only one juniper vine per post, and likewise one account per attested device key. Registration needs a device attestation proving a genuine handset or security key, and rotation is capped at one per year. To run a thousand Sybils, an attacker must buy, provision and maintain a thousand real devices, paying hardware and upkeep for each. A cloned key is caught when the same attestation appears twice, and both copies are frozen. Honest users pay nothing beyond the device they already own.
